# Disagreement Log — GTH_098

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** 98
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

| # | Verse | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Issue |
|---|-------|------|-------|--------|-------|
| 1 | 98 | "wished to kill" | "wanted to kill" | "wanted to kill" | Intention verb: wish vs. want |
| 2 | 98 | "stuck it into the wall" | "thrust it into the wall" | "drove it into the wall" | Wall-stabbing verb: stuck vs. thrust vs. drove |
| 3 | 98 | "whether his hand could carry through" | "whether his hand would be strong enough" | "whether his arm was up to the task" | Test of capability: hand/carry-through vs. strength |
| 4 | 98 | "he slew the powerful man" | "he went and killed the strong man" | "he went and killed the powerful man" | Final action: slew vs. killed; went vs. no movement |

**Total disagreements: 4**

---

**Resolution:** SOPHIA adopts "wished" (deliberate intention), "stuck" (most literal for *sōk*), "whether his hand could carry through" (preserves the Coptic compound meaning), and "slew" (deliberate and complete action).
